args.query:
SELECT
    eventTime,
    userIdentity.arn        AS caller_arn,
    userIdentity.type       AS identity_type,
    userIdentity.accountId  AS caller_account,
    awsRegion,
    requestParameters,
    responseElements,
    errorCode,
    errorMessage
FROM cloudtrail_events
WHERE eventName = 'DeleteSecurityGroup'
  AND recipientAccountId = '518306274913'
  AND eventTime >= '2026-09-03T07:00:00Z'
  AND eventTime <= '2026-09-03T08:30:00Z'
ORDER BY eventTime ASC
